answer.see: Plain white screen with a green star-shaped/origami-like logo graphic in the center, faint left-edge pinkish bar, Android status bar at top (6:20 PM, 80%). No text, no menu, no HUD.
answer.why: Early boot: a white splash with a green emblem, not yet a title or menu. Wait for the logo sequence to advance before pressing anything; no input yet.

answer.see: Publisher logo: a blue-lit billboard-style emblem reading 'GRAVE' with 'ENTERTAINMENT' beneath it, under a misty sky. FPS: 59 overlay top-left. No menu or HUD.
answer.why: Publisher logo (Grave Entertainment) before any title or menu; skip with A first, per the logo-skip guidance. No cursor visible.

answer.see: White screen with a grey metallic 'RenderWare' wordmark centred and a small ® mark at upper right. FPS: 59 overlay top-left. No other text, no HUD.
answer.why: RenderWare middleware logo before any title or menu; per the logo-skip hint, press A first and re-read.

answer.see: Strike Force Bowling title logo on black: blue oval, bowling pins, gold lane, 'BOWLING' letters. Copyright text block at bottom (© 2004 LAB Rats Games, Crave Entertainment). No 'Press Start' prompt visible. FPS: 59 overlay top-left.
answer.why: Game logo/copyright splash before the title; per the hints, A skips intro/logo screens first, then re-read.

answer.see: Strike Force Bowling title art over a night skyline. Main Menu header in script. Items: Open Play (highlighted yellow), Skins, Tournament, Challenge, Golf Mode, Practice, Xbox Live, Options. Footer: D-pad 'Menu Entry', A 'Open Play'.
answer.why: Main menu with Open Play highlighted in yellow, the fastest route to play with defaults. Pressing A accepts it.

answer.see: Bowler Entry screen, pink title 'Bowler Entry'. Left panel 'Bowlers' is empty. Right panel 'Bowler Setup' lists: Add Bowler (highlighted yellow), Load Bowler, Add CPU Bowler, Edit Bowler (greyed), Remove Bowler (greyed), Play Game. Footer: Menu Entry, A Add Bowler, B Cancel.
answer.why: Bowler setup menu; no bowler exists yet. Play Game is the fastest route but is not yet selectable with no bowler, so I need to add one. Add Bowler is highlighted; A accepts the default and opens bowler creation.

answer.see: PlayerSelect screen (pink title on teal patterned background). Left: Name: Mary Anne, Gender: Female, Handedness: Right, Age: 28, Origin: USA. Center: portrait carousel with a woman with dark red hair highlighted in the middle frame. Right: standing bowler figure holding a blue ball. Footer: D-pad Change, A Select, B Cancel.
answer.why: Bowler selection screen; the highlighted profile Mary Anne is a valid default. A selects her and moves toward play.

answer.see: Name Entry screen (Strike Force Bowling). Panel: Name: Player 1 (yellow), Strength/Accuracy/Curve bars, 'Done' below. Footer: Menu Entry, A Edit Name, B Cancel. Letter wheel at top shows ABC..., END/DEL at left.
answer.why: Bowler name entry; the hint says to leave the default name and choose Done. The highlight is not clearly on Done, and A here edits the name, so I will move DOWN to Done first.

answer.see: Name Entry screen. Title banner 'Name Entry'. Panel shows Name: Player 1, Strength/Accuracy/Curve bars, and a Done option. Footer: Menu Entry, Change Strength, Cancel (B). Highlighted row: Strength (yellow). FPS overlay top-left.
answer.why: Bowler name entry panel with default name Player 1 already filled; the hint says accept the default and choose Done. Strength is highlighted, so I move DOWN past Accuracy and Curve to reach Done, then A.

answer.see: Bowler Entry screen. Left panel 'Bowlers' lists five '--- EMPTY ---' slots. Right panel 'Save Bowler' lists Page 1 (highlighted, yellow), Page 2, Page 3, Page 4, Page 5, and 'Do Not Save'. Footer: Menu Entry, A Page 1, B Cancel.
answer.why: Bowler save-slot menu with Page 1 highlighted as the default. Saving the new bowler to Page 1 with A is the path to play; 'Do Not Save' would also work but Page 1 is the default.

answer.see: Bowler Entry screen. Left panel 'Bowlers' lists five '--- EMPTY ---' rows, the top one highlighted in yellow. Right panel 'Save Bowler' lists Page 1 (yellow, highlighted), Page 2, Page 3, Page 4, Page 5, Do Not Save. Footer: Menu Entry, A --- EMPTY ---, B Cancel.
answer.why: A on Page 1 looped back twice, so the save target is not the blocker. The cursor sits in the Save Bowler panel while the Bowlers list is all EMPTY; moving LEFT to the Bowlers panel and pressing A on the highlighted empty slot should assign a bowler first.

answer.see: Bowler Entry screen. Center dialog titled 'Save': 'Do you want to save the bowler?' with YES (highlighted, yellow) above NO (white). Background list shows bowler slots, one row highlighted yellow. Footer: Menu Entry, A --- EMPTY ---, B Cancel.
answer.why: Save confirmation dialog with YES already highlighted; choosing YES saves the new bowler and should move the flow toward play. Read the highlight: YES is the lit option.

answer.see: Bowler Entry screen. Left panel 'Bowlers' lists Player 1. Right panel 'Bowler Setup' lists Add Bowler (highlighted yellow), Load Bowler, Add CPU Bowler, Edit Bowler, Remove Bowler, Play Game. Footer: A Add Bowler, B Cancel.
answer.why: A bowler now exists (Player 1), so the goal is to start play. Cursor is on Add Bowler, which loops back. Moving 5 rows DOWN to Play Game and confirming with A.

answer.see: Stage Select screen (pink neon title). Three lanes shown: left a Japanese garden bridge, center a bowling alley with 'LA... BASS' banner (highlighted, large center), right a dark city. Footer: Change (D-pad), A Select, B Cancel.
answer.why: Stage select is a menu after the bowler is set up; the centre stage is the one in focus, so accept it with A to start play.

answer.see: Bowling game intro card: large orange 'Player 1' lettering over a female bowler holding a teal ball; bottom text reads 'Press (A) to continue'. Bowling alley snack bar background, no HUD.
answer.why: Bowler setup card with 'Press A to continue' prompt; no cursor to move, so A accepts and advances toward play.
